name: reel_primo_musica_a
prompt: Catchy, upbeat Caribbean dembow-pop instrumental for a luxury real estate Instagram Reel, 105 BPM, playful and contagious. Punchy dembow drum pattern with crisp snares, warm 808 bass, bright marimba and plucked guitar hook that repeats and gets stuck in your head, light tropical synth chords, small risers before drops, a fun brass stab accent. Starts instantly with the hook (no intro), builds energy at the middle, ends with a clean final hit. Elegant, modern, feel-good, radio quality mix.
